prompt: Raise money for families affected by floods in Sindh
title: Rebuild After the Water
tagline: The water has gone down. The need hasn't. Help 300 families in Dadu get back on their feet.
story: Months after the floods, families in Dadu district are still living in tents next to the homes they lost. Children have missed a full term of school and most families have lost their only source of income.
Our student team is working with a local relief network to deliver ration packs, clean water and seed kits so farmers can plant before the season ends. Every purchase is made in Sindh.
Relief fades from the news fast. Your PKR 4,500 feeds a family of six for two weeks. Stay with them a little longer.

impactUnits.label: Water filter for a whole settlement

faqs.a: Volunteers from a registered local relief network, accompanied by two of our student coordinators on every trip.
Using a needs survey run with village elders, prioritising widows, the elderly and households with infants.

faqs.q: Will I see where my money went?
faqs.a: Yes. You'll get an Impact Wrapped showing the exact ration batches and villages your donation reached.

whatsappPitch: 🌊 Dadu is still underwater in every way that matters. Students are delivering ration packs to 300 families. PKR 4,500 feeds a family for 2 weeks. Please give & forward 🙏
